description.zh: 是否全部删除，只针对tags为空时有效。取值范围： true  false True False   默认是 false
description.en:
Specifies whether to delete all tags. This parameter is valid only when tags are empty. Valid values:

- true
- false
- True
- False

Default value: false.
The resource IDs. You can specify up to 50 subkeys.

description.zh: 对应标签键列表，最多包含20个子项
description.en: The list of tag keys. You can specify up to 20 subkeys.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun apig untag-resources --resource-type gateway --resource-id gw-xxx --tag-key env --all true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun apig DELETE /v1/tags --region cn-hangzhou --All true --ResourceId '["gw-xxx"]' --TagKey '["env"]' --ResourceType gateway --header "Content-Type=application/json"
